# The Kb-a guide

Kb-a is a small tool. This lead is the text before the first H2.

## Install (v1)

Run the installer. It needs nothing else: no database, no daemon and no account. The installer writes one binary into a folder on the path, and it can be removed by deleting that file again.

```sh
# this is a comment in a fence, not a heading
kb-a install
```

### Usage

Run `kb-a run`. Then read the output.

### Usage

A second heading with the same text.
